ms.promise:
Note to the reviewer: Milestones 1 and 3 of the original proposal are combined in this milestone in support of the 4-milestone structure. The system will be comprised of a web portal and a single mobile app for demining operations.
(A) UI/UX design for the system portal
(B) Development of the system portal, including admin interface for portal activity monitoring
(C) API backend, including backend for document indexing
(D) Smart contract for hash saving. Instead of storing entire documents on the blockchain (which can be costly due to storage limitations), you store the hashes of documents. The hash, along with metadata like a timestamp or document ID, is sent to the smart contract and stored on the blockchain.
(E) Ledger for site management, reporting and certification

Backend functionality:
- API service built with Golang, deployed on AWS Lambda. Provides REST APIs with role-based endpoints for security and flexibility. User authentication and authorization handled via AWS Cognito.
- Indexer service built with Golang, deployed on Amazon ECS. Collects transaction data from blockchain and payment system APIs. Runs as a single instance.
Frontend functionality
- Web client built with Next.js. Interacts with backend via REST API. Supports user roles: demining companies, donors.
Main feature: interactive map of demining zones (Mapbox). Users can view, select zones, and upload/download related files (coordinates, media, documents).
(D) Smart contract scheme included in the milestone report
The smart contract is developed in Solidity and deployed on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC). 
Its main purpose is to retrieve new data hashes and store them on the blockchain. 
The structure of the contract is intentionally simple and designed only to keep the latest data hash together with the application ID that corresponds to it. A private key is securely stored in the API backend, and each new transaction is signed with this key before being submitted to the blockchain.
